items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: I don't know Stanley's name. All I know about Stanley, he's a wonderful drummer.

ctx.x: Yeah, well Bill had some around here.

Well I do know Sidney Montague, the drummer, and let's see who else. Stanley, well those guys was playing in the big bands. What are you used to do with that big band? Now this guy, Alfred Martin, I think he used to name.
